title: China rebukes Amodei's chip-control slowdown essay as 'fearmongering'
summary: China's Foreign Ministry called Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's essay urging a paced frontier and continued US chip curbs 'fearmongering', saying confrontation disrupts global AI governance.
reason: Official dismissal in a US-China AI governance dispute.

title: Report: hundreds of contractors read real ChatGPT conversations under 'Project Lily'
summary: 404 Media reported that contractors hired via Crossing Hurdles and paid through Mercor review real ChatGPT conversations that can contain sensitive personal details; OpenAI says identifiers are stripped.
reason: Privacy exposure of user data at scale.
